req.title: Register rejects duplicate username
req.statement: The system shall render an error message when POST /auth/register is called with a username already present in the users table.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /auth/register must render an error message when a duplicate username is submitted. The error message format is 'User <name> is already registered.' The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a new unique username registers successfully with HTTP 302 redirect to /auth/login; (2) a negative/EP case confirming that submitting an existing username (from pre-loaded data, e.g. 'Rahul') returns HTTP 200 with the exact error message; (3) a boundary/STC case confirming the state transition — first registration succeeds, second identical registration fails with the exact error string; (4) a DT case covering the decision table branch where username exists but password is valid; (5) a NEG case verifying the error message contains the exact username interpolated into the string, catching constant/string mutations.

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_new_unique_username_succeeds():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'NewUser99', 'password': 'securepass'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
    assert b'already registered' not in r.data

test_register_new_unique_username_succeeds()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_duplicate_no_redirect_on_error():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert b'User James is already registered.' in r.data
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/auth/login' not in location

test_register_duplicate_no_redirect_on_error()
